function: DRL jointly sets BS transmit power, active-RIS reflection amplitude and phase, and active RIS ratio to maximize energy efficiency under jamming; a Stackelberg game selects channels (p. 1, 3-4).
system: Active RIS on a UAV (S=50-350 elements, fixed at (200,200,100) m); BS with L=60-antenna ULA, K=3 single-antenna UEs, target, jammer; 2 GHz carrier, 5 MHz (p. 2, 5).
method: Reinforcement learning: Stackelberg-game-guided soft double DDPG (SG-SD3) with twin critics, sparse reward equal to EE when constraints hold; Adam, learning rate 1e-5 (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Custom simulator, online interaction, no dataset: BS-RIS Rician fading with path loss; 800x800x100 m area, UEs and jammer on predetermined trajectories; other channel models unspecified (p. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Single simulated environment; agents compared by EE versus training episodes, max BS power 2-5 W and RIS size 50-350; no separate test scenario or unseen condition stated (p. 5-6).
baselines: Learned: SG-TD3 (Stackelberg game plus TD3); non-learned: random resource allocation, channel-selection-only scheme without RIS optimization (p. 5).
metrics: Energy efficiency (Mbps/J) versus max BS power; beampattern gain versus RIS elements; average reward per episode; channel-selection probabilities; 62.5% EE gain over SG-TD3 at 2.5 W (p. 5-6).
complexity: Order O(3(Z+Y)V + 3(U-1)V^2 + 2V) for SD3 versus O(2(Z+Y)V + 2(U-1)V^2 + V) for DDPG; no runtime or FLOPs reported (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "follows a Rician fading" is all that defines the BS-RIS link (with its own path loss); RIS-UE and target channels are not described. No 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data (setup, p. 5).
q2_support: p. 6: "different numbers of RIS ranging from 50 to 350" and BS power 2-5 W are sweeps of the simulated environment; the action space grows with S (p. 4), and no trained policy is said to be tested outside its training setting.
q3_support: p. 5: "a random resource allocation scheme, denoted by Random Scheme" is non-learned; p. 5: "twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3)" is the learned baseline; p. 6: "achieves a 62.5% increase in EE compared to the SG-TD3-Based UAV-RIS ISAC scheme".
q4_support: p. 4: "the overall complexity is approximately" O(3(Z+Y)V + 3(U-1)V^2 + 2V) for SG-SD3 (Sec. III-C); no measured runtime is given.
q5_support: p. 5: "The simulation is conducted within a Cartesian coordinate space" of the authors' own design; no code or data link, DOI or repository is given and no public dataset is used.
notes: Included, area 6 by the specificity order: aerial link with a UAV-mounted RIS, learned BS power and RIS control, with sensing; areas 5 (ISAC) and 3 (RIS configuration) also fit, reviewer may confirm. Anti-jamming channel selection is the Stackelberg game; the learned SD3 agent sets BS power and RIS coefficients, so function passes. q3 counts SG-TD3 as a standard DRL algorithm on the same problem and the random scheme as non-learned.
